mainEntity.name: Is every project in the portfolio client work?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The planned initial cohort is an unpaid, learning-first, part-time apprenticeship. There is no participation fee. Read the terms before applying; unpaid participation is not a promise of future paid work.

mainEntity.name: Is a job guaranteed after 12 weeks?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. High-performing Launchpad participants receive priority consideration for future paid project, freelance, internship, part-time or permanent opportunities at Zqtion as suitable roles, revenue and business needs become available. Selection depends on performance, business need, revenue, legal eligibility and availability.

mainEntity.name: Can beginners and first-year university students apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. First-year students, recent graduates, self-taught learners and career switchers are welcome. Most tracks do not require a previous job, internship, certificate, perfect portfolio or computer-science degree.

mainEntity.name: Can school or college students apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: The initial cohort is limited to applicants aged 18 or older who are legally eligible in an accepted jurisdiction. Under-18 enrollment is not offered; separate consent, privacy and safeguarding procedures would be needed first.

mainEntity.name: Is it remote, and how much time is needed?

acceptedAnswer.text: The program is remote-first, part-time, approximately 8–12 hours each week for 12 weeks. Session times, start dates and accepted locations must be confirmed before enrollment.

mainEntity.name: Are all 42 places guaranteed to be filled?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Fourteen tracks with up to three places each creates a maximum advertised capacity of 42. Actual places depend on mentor capacity and suitable learning work; Zqtion may fill fewer places or defer a track.

mainEntity.name: What is required for the certificate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meaningful participation, completed required assignments, a final project, professional conduct and mentor approval. Registration or attendance alone does not earn a certificate.

mainEntity.name: Will I be doing unpaid employee work?

acceptedAnswer.text: The program is designed around structured training and supervised, low-risk practice, not unsupervised replacement of paid employees. Apprentices must not independently control contracts, payments, production secrets, commercial commitments or publication.
Application, shortlist, a 30–60 minute practical challenge, a 15–20 minute conversation, then selection. The challenge should be bounded practice, not an unpaid production deliverable.

mainEntity.name: Do I need paid tools or a public portfolio?

acceptedAnswer.text: No expensive AI subscription or polished portfolio is required. Share something you have tried, even a learning experiment. Tools depend on the track and approved access. Never share private client data or credentials.
